title: Gorenaire: Seasonal
summary: Seasonal Gorenaire pulses frost damage until her icy shell breaks.
overview: Seasonal Gorenaire pulses frost damage until her icy shell breaks.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Players within 60 units take the scripted frost pulse every ten seconds.
Keep ranged players outside that area when their abilities allow it and cover the melee group with healing.
At 15%, the pulse stops and the boss becomes more vulnerable to two-handed blunt and two-handed slashing attacks.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 200.
Only the version-200 custom mechanics are documented. The standard open-zone spawn does not run these combat timers.

Health-phase comments label skills 2 and 3 incorrectly; guidance follows the skill numbers (two-handed blunt and two-handed slashing). The howl timer is commented out, so no recurring scripted howl is claimed.
